verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents an official MCP server for AI assistants such as Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Windsurf. It also offers Python and TypeScript SDKs and a REST API, which give generic integration paths an agent framework could wrap. However, the evidence shows no documented adapters for any of the named frameworks. Missing for 10: documented adapters or integration guides for Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain and CrewAI; evidence that the MCP server is supported from agent SDKs rather than only desktop or IDE assistants; independent corroboration of any framework integration.
